correctness.rationale: For all a,b>=2, the four-dimensional image W has a directly computed adjacency action, with p(x)=x^4-(ab-1)x^2+(a-1)(b-1). The proof establishes exact minimal polynomials for the six unordered residues, including the unique four-vertex exception and the nilpotent extensions. The cyclic module identity R(t)=t^deg(m_A)m_A(t+t^{-1}) proves exact temporal invariant factors and their orders; factoring over F3 proves the entire period table. In residue (2,2), W is invertible, V=W direct-sum ker A, and temporal factors Phi5, Phi10, t^2+1 give the all-time nullity and maximal-period probability. The supplied checker independently computed 49 matrix orders, 360 nullity comparisons and exhaustive 6561-state boundary populations. These finite checks corroborate the mathematical proof but do not replace it.

value.rationale: The natural and highly constrained defect operation K_{a,b}->K_{a,b}-e yields a complete six-residue sharp-period classification and an exceptional boundary, including both period reduction (12 to 10) and large increases (12 to 36). The period-twenty cases split into genuinely different cyclotomic and zero-mode mixing mechanisms; this is a structural distinction not a routine numerical increment. The every-time census and maximal-period density in one infinite residue family give an exact invariant with a natural dynamical interpretation. The finding remains limited to characteristic three.
